conditions.leftValue: ={{ $json.req.allowed && !$json.control.stop_new_authors && $json.queue.length > 0 && $json.attempted.length < $json.limits.max_pages && $json.round_pages.length < Math.max(1, $json.limits.target_sources - $json.assessments.filter(a => a.usable && a.identity_match === "match" && a.independence === "no_obvious_overlap" && $json.webfacts.some(f => f.source_id === a.source_id)).length) }}
